status: DESIGN PROPOSAL ONLY. Offering and independent gap review must be approved before implementation and prospective freeze.
not_a_result: No simulation has been run for this offering.
No price, demand, privacy preference, human task hours, mission acceptance probability, insurance premium or actual complete cost has been measured.
Actual customer collections are zero; actual research/construction expenditure remains unknown.
No numerical result, revenue, profit, measured efficiency gain or demand estimate transfers from the preserved battery study.

offering.name: Confidential pre-emergency reserve-pool feasibility assessment
offering.paying_buyer: An association or consortium sponsor purchasing one agreed assessment for three named utility owners.
offering.scope: Three owner/computing parties; two padded asset slots per party; six public demand locations. Private eligibility, scenario availability and owner-retention constraints remain at separately controlled parties. Return one aggregate feasible/not-feasible bit for the entire authorized scenario family, together with public scope, version, verification and release-policy evidence.
offering.origin: All six single-demand and fifteen two-demand failure sets: 21 scenarios, represented only by their aggregate conjunction.
offering.successor: A separately authorized epoch can add twenty three-demand events. If it includes the origin family, all 41 scenarios must be evaluated. A successor is separately scoped and priced; no extra sale is assumed in the primary volume.
customer_prerequisites: All three owners authorize the same purpose, public scenario family, one-bit release and finite query epoch.
Each owner supplies rights-cleared, internally checked compatibility/eligibility, availability and retained-minimum constraints; these are not inferred or physically certified by the agent.
Each owner operates or controls its private runtime endpoint and credentials. Three local research processes are not evidence of three independent organizations.
offering.acceptance: Correct complete computation of the agreed aggregate predicate with the declared transcript/integrity and release checks. Bit=0 is a valid accepted result. Partial scenario execution, missing owner consent, unsupported privacy assumptions or incorrect output is failed delivery, not an accepted pessimistic result.
boundaries: No inventory ownership transfer, capacity reservation, dispatch right, insurance indemnity, outage prevention claim or physical equipment release.
No novel cryptographic primitive, malicious-security claim or privacy guarantee beyond the supported deployment/threat model.
One aggregate bit can itself reveal information; the buyer must accept that specified release.
No per-scenario counterexample, allocation plan or emergency availability guarantee is sold.
offering.value_relevance: This is a prospective decision instrument for whether to fund a more detailed shared-reserve arrangement. Its informational value may be zero when the aggregate bit cannot change a real next decision or the physical approvals dominate that decision.

sources.fact: May 2025 US employee median annual wages: software developers USD135980; QA analysts/testers USD104300. Not consultant prices.
May 2025 US computer/information research scientist median annual wage USD140300; employee-wage proxy, not an MPC specialist quote.
May 2025 US information-security analyst median annual wage USD129180; employee-wage proxy, not an independent security-audit quote.
May 2025 US electrical-engineer median USD120630; electric power generation/transmission/distribution industry median USD122430. The industry wage is used for the domain-role proxy.
May 2025 US lawyer median annual wage USD159670. These data exclude self-employed workers and owners/partners of unincorporated businesses; not an outside-counsel billing rate.
June 2026 private-industry employer cost USD46.89/hour: wages USD32.82 and benefits USD14.07. Broad benefits proxy, not occupation-specific overhead.

SPAREConnect describes decentralized points of contact, no central asset database and voluntary equipment sharing. Requests concern emergencies or non-routine failures. This supports a distinction from a prospective collective assessment, not proof that no private assessment already exists.

Grid Assurance describes confidential warehouse locations and cost-based subscription fees. Dedicated reserve access is an existing approach; its fees are not used as the price of this information product.

human_led_comparison.basis: A human-led R&D pathway using standard MPC and the same discovered formulation. No invented equivalent-service selling price and no conversion of R&D expense into buyer willingness to pay.
human_led_comparison.labor_formula: sum(role_hours * annual_employee_wage/2080 * 46.89/32.82 * explicitly assumed expertise multiplier) + nonlabor overhead + listed tools/compute. 2080 is an assumed full-time-equivalent divisor.
human_led_comparison.no_double_counting: The benefit factor includes the broad benefits burden. Nonlabor overhead at 10/15/25% covers workspace, shared IT and equipment only; it excludes benefits, explicit coordination, review hours and separately listed tools. No silent inflation escalation or supplier operating margin is added.

roles.scoped_task: Specify the supplied eligibility, availability and retention semantics; no physical inspection or equipment qualification.
Use an existing MPC library and the disclosed formulation; implement the bounded aggregate predicate, not new cryptography.
Three-process orchestration, supplied synthetic input adapters, error paths and reproducible packaging.
Compare against cleartext exhaustive controls; run malformed, unavailable, retention and simultaneous-demand cases.
Record threat-model limits, methods, source provenance and the runnable handoff.

research_fixture.meaning: Same supplied synthetic fixture and standard MPC construction as the research execution, not a production deployment or autonomous discovery trial. Hours, success probabilities and dates are planning estimates, not human measurements.

roles.scoped_task: Define owner-asserted eligibility semantics, authorized event families and limits across the three operators; no physical certification.
Adapt standard MPC, query release policy, input integrity checks, failure recovery and protected repeat operation.
Three separately controlled endpoints, signed configuration, client adapters and secure deployment/recovery.
Review implementation and deployment threat assumptions, metadata leakage, allowed queries and incident procedures.
Adversarial cases, deterministic oracle comparisons, independent reproduction and release validation.
Define consent, disclosure limits, liability allocation, refund terms and no physical reserve obligation.
Coordinate three organizations and acceptance gates; excluded from generic nonlabor overhead.

live_pilot_readiness.verification_included: Independent correctness, security/deployment review and repeatable release tests are explicit role-hours. Permission and operating-organization acceptance are additional real uncertainties.
live_pilot_readiness.financing: Sponsor or company funds staged R&D before accepted service revenue. A failed attempt consumes the work already incurred. No free unlimited retries and no expected-cost/one-success division that hides elapsed time or capital.

ai_productization_startup.status: Forward deployment-readiness estimates for this exact offering; distinct from both actual unmetered research and the human-led pathways.

roles.scoped_task: One-time review of the actual code, permitted leakage and separately controlled deployments before confidential customer use.
Establish three owner-controlled execution endpoints and recovery/configuration procedures; no vendor control of all private endpoints.
One-time supported input schema and decision-purpose qualification. Owners supply all physical eligibility judgments.
Consent, release/responsibility agreements and insurer/subscriber review. Does not claim legal enforceability or bind physical reserves.
Reperform technical oracle/reproduction checks on the productized configuration.

ai_productization_startup.model_tariff_basis: Use the existing official frontier source record for tariffs; consumption above is unmeasured. Private owner inputs must not be sent to a frontier model. Models see public schemas, authorized releases and sanitized errors only.
ai_productization_startup.human_scope_reason: These estimates concern the unexecuted security, governance and independent operator setup required by the proposed live configuration. They are not an arbitrary manual review surcharge on each automated assessment.
ai_productization_startup.automation_boundary: Reducing implementation work through expert agents is a plausible budget mechanism, not a measured H/E efficiency result. The gap between the two startup pathways is not reported as Operational Alpha. Stress replacement/productization costs at the human-led pathway levels.
ai_productization_startup.staged_failure: Propose a bounded planning gate after 20% of startup spend and technical/deployment review after another 40%; remaining 40% is spent only after passing. Explicit gate probabilities must be frozen before simulation; total readiness probability is not multiplied twice.
ai_productization_startup.charge_rule: All necessary forward startup work is charged once to originating production/readiness (A0). No automatic second research bill for learning already included. Current unpaid research construction is separately unknown, never described as paid-job learning.

qualified_pool_opportunities.distribution: Discrete 3/6/9 over the whole six-month horizon, probabilities .25/.50/.25
qualified_pool_opportunities.definition: A named sponsor with a real prospective reserve question and three candidate owners, not a completed consented sale or a claim about total addressable market.
qualified_pool_opportunities.arrival: Spread prospectively over days 0..150; available capacity, readiness and approval delay may prevent closing before day 180.

capacity.growth: No extra customers or capacity are assumed from larger market size, successful fixtures or retained skill count.

commercial_world.correlation: Use a shared pool-specific governance/readiness factor plus member-specific variation. Never assume that three independent high consent rates establish an actual coalition. All members must consent; no dropping difficult owners, assets or scenarios.
commercial_world.common_failure: Include a world-level deployment flaw or operator outage affecting multiple jobs; its rate and duration are assumptions to freeze. Model agreement does not establish correctness.
commercial_world.no_launch: Always include no-launch as a commercial policy with zero new forward spend. Already incurred research cost remains reported separately rather than used to compel launch.

buyer_value_and_participation.value_formula: V_pool = confidence * [p_decision_change * avoidable_next_planning_exposure + independently avoidable coordination_hours * relevant loaded labor rate]. Subtract all owner input/runtime expense and accepted disclosure/coordination burden. This is a scenario for decision value, not estimated avoided outage loss.
buyer_value_and_participation.input_effort_rule: Customer-side preparation and physical eligibility assertions are prerequisites and are included in buyer participation cost, not falsely booked as zero-effort AI production or vendor revenue. If separately sold by the provider, both scope and vendor costs must change.
buyer_value_and_participation.association_sponsorship: Primary arrangement: association pays the single whole-pool fee; owners pay their own input/runtime costs. Sponsor evaluates aggregate member decision value and its finite budget; each member separately accepts its information and participation terms. Member reimbursements to the association are not additional vendor sales.
buyer_value_and_participation.individual_value_shares: Predeclare heterogeneous benefit shares summing to one. Every member must have nonnegative expected participation utility; aggregate surplus alone cannot override a harmed member.
buyer_value_and_participation.optional_arrangement: A 50% sponsor / 50% equal member cofunding policy may be compared, but recompute all individual participation conditions and acquisition/settlement costs. Do not multiply sponsor and member payments into duplicate revenue.
buyer_value_and_participation.bit_zero: A correct no-coverage answer may save premature coordination/R&D. Assign lower value when it cannot identify a remedy or when a known weakness already makes the result predictable. Do not force a positive information value for both outcomes.

outside_options.name: Trusted broker or in-house cleartext analysis
outside_options.availability: Only when all owners authorize disclosure to the proposed broker or shared team. Confidentiality preference is assumed, not measured.
outside_options.cost_basis: An internal competent analytical path, not a quoted market service: 8/16/32 domain-analyst hours plus 4/8/16 governance hours and USD200/500/1500 tools; use the corresponding wage/benefit assumptions. No need to develop MPC.
outside_options.advantage: Same scenario meaning and exact conventional solver can be used; provide the discovered formulation to the control. If acceptable, this cheaper route should usually defeat the new offering.

outside_options.name: Existing resilience arrangements
outside_options.availability: Existing contact networks, own spares and dedicated shared reserve access remain real choices.
outside_options.cost_basis: Do not invent their prices or equate their physical/responsibility scope with one aggregate assessment bit. They can make the assessment unnecessary.

outside_options.name: No purchase / postpone
outside_options.rule: A low-value, low-confidence, nonconsenting or cheaper-alternative pool abstains. Price changes must recompute selection.

falsifiers: No owner group has the binding nondisclosure restriction.
Owners permit a trusted broker or cannot accept the MPC deployment/output leakage.
One aggregate bit has no useful effect on a funded next decision.
Input preparation, physical checks or governance dominate any saved effort.
Sponsor budgets, price-sensitive uptake or common failure remove the profitable region.

pricing_and_funds.candidate_policy_family: Nine fee/deposit combinations plus no-launch, primary full association sponsorship. No globally optimal policy claim. Add cofunding only if its full participation model is completed before freezing.
pricing_and_funds.invoice_terms: Remaining balance due 30 days after accepted complete delivery; noncollection and 30/60/90-day lateness are modeled.
pricing_and_funds.fees_status: Payment costs are explicit assumptions, not a processor quote. Accrue fees attributable to accepted unpaid receivables before the reporting date; release the fee liability when a written-off balance is never collected.
pricing_and_funds.deposits: Receive only after all three owners accept the fixed scope. Deposits remain restricted refund liabilities until accepted delivery. They cannot fund production or be counted as service revenue.
pricing_and_funds.refund: No accepted delivery means full customer-fee refund, plus actual nonrefundable collection/refund charges. Infeasible aggregate coverage alone is not a delivery failure.
pricing_and_funds.admission: Reserve own funds using declared ex-ante upper resource/retry/support/refund/settlement limits, not realized future token draws or knowledge of future mission outcomes. Do not book beyond working cash.
pricing_and_funds.reserve: Hold all unearned deposits, accrued unpaid expenses, unspent delivery commitments, support/processing obligations and two months of fixed operating cost. Reserve is a cash restriction, not an extra expense.
pricing_and_funds.settlement: Report day180 revenue/cost/profit, cash, receivables, unearned deposits, accrued liabilities, reserves and available funds separately; then close only the existing cohort in the settlement tail. Tail support/collection/archive expenses must be prepaid/accrued, not silently free.
pricing_and_funds.objective: Among finite tested policies, maximize mean day180 available operating funds after all liabilities/reserves and excluding initial seed; report contribution/operating profit separately and retain the full loss distribution.

complete_forward_costs.A0: One-time productization costs listed above. Necessary originating construction and verification, not B retention or optional Gym.
complete_forward_costs.retries: Draw bounded retry demand and apply only to attempt-dependent categories. Failed attempts still incur their costs; support and accepted-output obligations are charged once. Candidate retry multiplier bounds 1..2, to be frozen.
complete_forward_costs.residual_human_sensitivity: If independent human review or per-customer custom integration proves required, test +8/+24 expert hours per booking and rerun demand, capacity and financing; do not label that configuration the automated baseline.
complete_forward_costs.business_fixed_scope: Recurring baseline software/administration/patching and operating infrastructure, after readiness. No duplicated startup overhead or recurring human hours already listed in A.
complete_forward_costs.acquisition_scope: Sponsor outreach, proposal and procurement effort/tool expense for every qualified opportunity, including nonconsenting and lost pools; not only successful sales.
complete_forward_costs.underwriting_boundary: Unquoted planning allowance for technology/cyber/service responsibility, not physical-grid or outage insurance. No assumed insurer payment without actual coverage terms. A premium does not prove a contract is insurable.
complete_forward_costs.common_security_failure_stress: Model refund of affected assessments, suspension of future sales and USD25000/100000 remediation shocks. Claim no guarantee that those amounts bound all losses; if the required responsibility cannot be funded or insured, reject this commercial configuration.

B_optional_retention.primary: No extra retention campaign or assessment. Repeat invocation of the product already constructed in A is in the operating baseline.
B_optional_retention.candidate: A rights-cleared query-policy or constraint-adapter improvement evaluated on new missions, without owner constraints/secret shares/protected outputs.
B_optional_retention.decision: Reject unless fresh expected incremental value covers all B expense under bounded future reuse. Same-information ordinary-library access receives the same content and must be a control.

C_optional_Gym.rule: No mandatory training campaign. A separate bounded experiment requires a complete investment case, explicit stop condition and independent fresh transfer test.

complete_forward_costs.actual_vs_model: All dollar costs here are forward estimates; actual complete research cost remains unknown. Seed, customer savings, insurance proceeds, pooled reserve asset value and token issuance are not earned service revenue.

mandatory_worlds: No privacy-demand segment; all owners accept the cheaper broker.
Three rather than six or nine qualified opportunities.
Low confidence/actionability and known-predictable aggregate bit.
Only 50% owner consent, with common organizational rejection.
Delay until late in the six-month horizon.
Productization at the human-led live-pilot cost, with no assumed agent savings.
Confidentiality/operational incident with common refunds and stopped sales.
Ordinary identical-content library ties E+; retained gain zero or negative.

proposed_seed_plan.status: Tentative and unused. Freeze the exact offering, distributions, scenarios, policy grid and implementation hash before inspecting fresh confirmation.

sensitivity_and_design.paired_controls: Use the same finite pools, owner preferences, consent and operational shocks across prices/terms and E/E+ cases. Realized future costs and shocks cannot enter booking or buyer decisions; only ex-ante beliefs do.
sensitivity_and_design.H_U_E_Eplus: H is the scoped human-led development pathway. U/E frontier mission success is unmeasured here. E+ gain must include zero/negative scenarios. No numeric Operational Alpha follows from standard MPC correctness or from the R&D cost budgets.
sensitivity_and_design.uncertainty_reporting: Report 5th/median/95th percentiles, failure/insolvency/refund rates, uptake and throughput, conditional-on-readiness delivery profit, all-in venture operating result, and parameter stresses. Monte Carlo sampling uncertainty does not validate assumed demand or values.

arithmetic_only_break_even_check.assumptions: Pure planning identity, not simulated or forecast sales: central startup, five operating months, six qualified opportunities, USD3000 premium, USD1200 cost per accepted assessment, all billed amounts collected, .5% payment fee, no failed deliveries or extra costs.
arithmetic_only_break_even_check.limitation: Failures, discounts, customer participation, delays, lost collections and ex-ante finance reserves change these thresholds. The USD6000 case requires more sales than the central six-opportunity pipeline; a positive region at higher prices requires enough owners and sponsors to accept those prices.

sensitivity_and_design.smallest_next_commercial_validation: For one explicitly consented three-owner group, obtain an actual next-decision budget and outside option, agree the exact one-bit query, time input preparation and secure an independently reviewed deployment quote/conditional paid assessment commitment. These are calibration steps, not prerequisites to the modeled research proposal.
sensitivity_and_design.stop_rule: Do not optimize a flattering profit narrative if independent prior art or participant review finds no useful nondisclosure gap. Preserve this proposal and pivot instead.
